description: A touring show producer must approve the recording plan for a one-night concert archive, including the recording format, artist credit, stagehand staffing, and crew call.

shared_context.S1: The concert is scheduled for one performance at the Orpheum Theater on September 18.
shared_context.S2: The production team has drafted a plan for a video recording with four stagehands on a four-hour crew call.
shared_context.S3: The recording is intended for the show's internal archive and is not currently scheduled for public release.
shared_context.S4: Morgan makes the binding approval for the recording plan.
shared_context.S5: At the final production meeting, Morgan routinely asks the artist liaison and labor coordinator to confirm their areas before approving the plan.

PF1.text: Riley received the artist's signed performance rider this morning; it permits an audio-only archival recording, prohibits any video recording, and requires the archive credit to read exactly 'Live at the Orpheum — The Juniper Set'. Riley has not attached the rider to the production file yet.

PF2.text: Sam confirmed with the theater's labor representative today that recording calls require exactly six stagehands and a minimum five-hour call under the local agreement. The staffing draft was prepared before that confirmation and has not been revised.

acceptance_conditions: The archival recording must be approved.
The artist credit must use the exact rider wording.
Exactly six stagehands must be scheduled.
The crew call must be exactly five hours.
The artist rider and labor requirements must each generate a logged production commitment.

content_checks.C2: decisions['artist_credit'] == 'Live at the Orpheum — The Juniper Set'
content_checks.C3: any(c['type'] in ['artist_rider_compliance', 'attach_rider', 'credit_formatting', 'follow-up', 'revision', 'revise_plan', 'metadata'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ['labor_compliance', 'update_staffing', 'follow-up', 'revision', 'revise_plan'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The signed rider changes the draft from a video recording to an approved audio-only recording, replaces any generic credit with the exact wording 'Live at the Orpheum — The Juniper Set', and requires an artist-rider compliance commitment.
The labor confirmation changes the draft staffing from four to exactly six stagehands, extends the crew call from four to exactly five hours, and requires a labor-compliance commitment.
